visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a dark grey t-shirt and glasses stands outdoors on a stone-paved plaza under the shade of a white tent. He speaks directly to the camera with active hand gestures. Behind him sits a massive cement mixer truck painted in striking gold and red, which has been converted into a giant gashapon machine with large colorful balls visible through transparent panels. (2) The camera provides a close-up of a hand holding two large silver tokens with intricate nautical patterns. In the background, a small boy in a white sweatshirt stands near the red bumper of the giant truck. A sign nearby displays various high-value prizes like flight tickets and electronics in bright colors. (3) A woman in a black-and-white striped sweater helps the small boy reach the coin slot on the side of the red machine body. They together turn a large wooden steering wheel-like handle with significant physical effort. A large white plastic capsule is seen rolling out into the retrieval tray at the bottom. (4) The boy stands at a wooden table cluttered with various boxed toys and items. A woman's hand reaches in to help him open the white capsule, revealing a prize box for a Pirate Barrel game. The boy looks down at the box with a focused and curious expression while the woman talks to him. (5) A little girl in a white shirt and pigtails tries her turn at the machine with the help of the woman. They turn the large wooden wheel again, and an orange plastic capsule drops out. The girl opens it to find a boxed Connect 4 travel game. The final shot pans across the prize table showing a wide variety of colorful toys.
